faq.meta_description: Answers about pricing, timelines, custom websites, and working with Blok Blok Studio, a Berlin-based web design studio serving clients worldwide.

items.question: How much does a custom website cost?
items.answer: A single landing page is $2,000, a 5-page site $6,500, 10 pages with a CMS $12,000, and 15 or more pages with e-commerce from $18,000. The same tiers apply whether it is a new site or a redesign of your current one. Pricing depends on the number of pages, custom animations, integrations and copywriting needs. Every site is built in Next.js, hosted on Vercel and SEO-optimized from day one, never templates.

items.question: Do you offer monthly hosting and care plans or just project work?
items.answer: Both. Project work starts at $2,000 and is billed in milestones. After launch, hosting and care plans start at $550/month for Site Care (monitoring, backups, security updates and small content edits), $1,600/month for Site Growth (a new page or section and A/B tests every month) and $3,800/month for Site Partnership (a dedicated developer and designer). Plans have a 3-month minimum.

items.question: How long does it take to build a custom website?
items.answer: A single landing page typically launches in 2 to 3 weeks. A 5-page site takes 4 to 6 weeks, a 10-page site with CMS 6 to 8 weeks, and 15 or more pages 8 to 12 weeks. Redesigns run on the same schedule. Timeline depends on how quickly you provide content, brand input and approvals.

items.question: What does the design and build process look like?
items.answer: Five phases: Discovery (your goals and audience), Strategy (a tailored roadmap), Design (visual concepts and prototypes), Development (modern, performant code), and Launch & Optimize (deploy, monitor, refine). You get weekly updates and a Loom walkthrough at every milestone, no live status meetings unless you want one.

items.question: Do you build in Next.js, WordPress or Webflow?
items.answer: By default we code by hand in Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, hosted on Vercel for sub-second load times. That is where the speed, the custom animations and the SEO results come from. If your situation calls for it, for example a team that already runs WordPress or a marketing site that needs Webflow's editor, we build there too.

items.question: Do you write the website copy, or do I provide it?
items.answer: Either works. Most clients provide raw notes or bullet points and we shape them into final copy. Full professional copywriting is included at the $18,000 tier and available as a $200/page add-on at any other tier.

items.question: Where is Blok Blok Studio located, and do you work internationally?
items.answer: Our studio is based in Berlin, Germany, with team members in Richmond, Los Angeles and Multan. Our clients are in the United States, Germany and the Philippines. Communication is asynchronous via Loom, email and text, so every time zone works. Invoicing and contracts are available in USD or EUR.

items.question: Do I own my website code?
items.answer: Yes, completely. On project completion you receive full ownership of the code and design files. The site is deployed to your own Vercel account under your billing, and the domain stays in your name from day one. We never lock clients into our systems.

items.question: Will my site be mobile-responsive and SEO-optimized?
items.answer: Yes, both are non-negotiable in every build. Mobile-first responsive design is tested at 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px. Every page ships with meta titles, descriptions, schema markup, alt text, and a sitemap submitted to Google. We target Lighthouse scores of 90+ for performance and 95+ for accessibility before launch.

privacy.legal_basis_contract: Contractual Necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)): When processing is necessary to fulfill a service agreement with you

privacy.legal_basis_withdraw: You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.commitment_content: Blok Blok Studio is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards across our website and the websites we build for clients.
accessibility.conformance_intro: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) define requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. They define three levels of conformance: Level A, Level AA, and Level AAA.
accessibility.conformance_status: blokblokstudio.com is partially conformant with WCAG 2.2 level AA. “Partially conformant” means that some parts of the content do not fully conform to the accessibility standard. See the known limitations section below for details.
accessibility.standard_wcag: WCAG 2.2 Level AA, the international baseline for web accessibility maintained by the W3C.
accessibility.standard_en301549: EN 301 549, the European harmonized standard for ICT accessibility that underpins the European Accessibility Act.
accessibility.standard_eaa: EU European Accessibility Act (Directive 2019/882), applicable to consumer-facing digital services in the EU since 28 June 2025.
accessibility.standard_ada: US Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Title III, accessibility obligations for public-facing commercial websites in the United States.
accessibility.standard_508: Section 508 of the US Rehabilitation Act, requirements for federal agencies and contractors, which we treat as a baseline for federal-adjacent work.
accessibility.measures_intro: Accessibility is part of how we design and build, not a one-time audit. Specifically, on this site:
accessibility.measure_landmarks: Semantic HTML landmarks (main, nav, header, footer) on every page.
accessibility.measure_skip_link: A “skip to main content” link for keyboard users.
accessibility.measure_focus: Visible focus indicators on every interactive element.
accessibility.measure_alt_text: Text alternatives on all meaningful images.
accessibility.measure_forms: Forms with associated labels, required-field announcements, and inline error messages exposed via aria-describedby and role="alert".
accessibility.measure_dialogs: Mobile menu and modal dialogs with keyboard focus management and Escape-to-close behavior.
accessibility.measure_reduced_motion: Respect for the prefers-reduced-motion setting in your operating system.
accessibility.measure_contrast: Color contrast meeting or exceeding WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text).
accessibility.measure_rtl: Right-to-left layout for Arabic, and a language switcher that announces each option in its native language and direction.
accessibility.measure_languages: Site available in 20 languages so non-English speakers can use it in the language they think in.
accessibility.limitations_intro: Despite our best efforts, some content on this site may not be fully accessible yet. Known issues we are working to resolve:
accessibility.limitation_third_party: Embedded third-party content, the Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA and the Google Calendar booking page inherit their own accessibility behavior from the upstream vendor. We track their conformance status with each vendor.
accessibility.limitation_motion: Decorative motion, ambient background animations are disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is set, but a small number of cursor-magnetic micro-interactions may still play.
accessibility.limitation_language: Statement language, the English version of this statement is the reference; other languages are translations of it. The site itself is available in 20 languages.
accessibility.feedback_intro: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on blokblokstudio.com, or need information from this site in an alternative format, please contact us. We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within five business days.
accessibility.feedback_form: Web form: Contact page, please mention “accessibility” in your message.
accessibility.enforcement_intro: Blok Blok Studio is based in Berlin, Germany. If you are not satisfied with our response to your accessibility feedback, you can escalate under your local enforcement framework:
accessibility.enforcement_eu: European Union, the market surveillance authority of the EU member state in which you are located. The EAA designates a national authority in each member state.
accessibility.enforcement_us: United States, the US Department of Justice Civil Rights Division for ADA complaints; the US Access Board for Section 508.
accessibility.preparation_content: This statement was prepared on {date} via a self-evaluation of the site against WCAG 2.2 AA. The evaluation combined an automated review of the live site with a manual review of the codebase (semantic structure, keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA usage, color contrast, motion handling, and locale direction). We re-review the site after every significant release.
accessibility.meta_description: Blok Blok Studio is committed to digital accessibility. Our site is built to meet WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508, and the EU European Accessibility Act.

oneTime.name: Single Page Launch
oneTime.tag: Best for a simple online presence

scope.l: One fully custom, mobile-responsive page built in Next.js: hero, offer, proof, contact. Responsive layout for desktop, tablet and mobile. SEO meta title and description written. SSL and hosting setup on Vercel included.
We work from your existing logo and colours, or pick a palette and type pairing with you if you do not have one yet. No template; the layout is drawn for your content.
A spam-protected form that lands in your inbox, with a confirmation message for the visitor.
Google Analytics 4 and Search Console connected, with conversion events on the form so you can see what the page produces.
Two structured revision rounds after the first design presentation. Changes are collected in one list per round so nothing gets lost.
You send notes or bullet points, we shape them into final copy for the page. Full professional copywriting is available as an add-on.

oneTime.ho: Payment: 50% deposit to start, 50% due upon completion (Net 7). Complete upon client sign-off OR after 2 revision rounds. Post-sign-off: $175/hr.
oneTime.bridge: Includes 14 days of post-launch monitoring (bug fixes and minor tweaks). Need more pages? Starter Launch covers five.
oneTime.ideal: Side projects, personal brands, simple landing pages

oneTime.name: Starter Launch

scope.i: Custom website (5 pages), new build or redesign
scope.l: Fully custom, mobile-responsive website built in Next.js: Home, About, Services, Contact and one page of your choice. Works for a brand-new site or a redesign of the one you have. SEO meta titles and descriptions for all five pages. SSL and hosting setup on Vercel included.
Built on your existing logo and colours, or a palette and type pairing chosen with you. Every section is designed for your content, not dropped into a theme.
Spam-protected contact form plus a booking link or embedded calendar, so visitors can get in touch or book a slot without emailing back and forth.
Meta titles and descriptions, Open Graph tags, structured data for your business, XML sitemap and robots.txt, submitted to Google Search Console at launch.
Google Analytics 4 and Search Console connected, with conversion events on forms and bookings.
Two structured revision rounds after the first design presentation.
You send notes or bullet points, we shape them into final copy for every page. Full professional copywriting is available as an add-on.

oneTime.ho: Payment: 50% deposit to start, 50% due upon completion (Net 7). Complete upon client sign-off OR after 2 revision rounds. Post-sign-off: $175/hr.
oneTime.bridge: Includes 30 days of post-launch monitoring (bug fixes and minor tweaks). After day 30, hosting and upkeep continue on Site Care ($550/mo).

oneTime.name: Growth Accelerator

scope.i: Custom website (10 pages + CMS), new build or redesign
scope.l: Ten fully custom pages built in Next.js with a content management system, so your team can edit text, images and posts without a developer. Works for a new site or a redesign. SEO meta data on every page. SSL and hosting setup on Vercel included.
Components, typography and colour defined once and reused across every page, so new pages added later look like they belong.

scope.i: Blog or news section you can edit
scope.l: A CMS-backed section with categories, author and date, article schema and social-share images generated per post.

scope.i: Lead and booking forms with notifications
scope.l: Multi-step or simple forms, spam protection, email notifications and a booking calendar embed, with every submission tagged by source.
Everything in the Starter technical setup plus local business schema, Google Business Profile alignment and location pages where relevant.
Core Web Vitals pass on mobile and desktop before launch: image optimisation, font loading and script budgets, verified with Lighthouse.
Google Analytics 4 and Search Console connected and a simple monthly view of traffic, leads and top pages.
Three structured revision rounds after the first design presentation.
You send notes or bullet points, we shape them into final copy for every page. Full professional copywriting is available as an add-on.

oneTime.ho: Payment: 50% deposit to start, 50% due upon completion (Net 7). Complete upon sign-off OR 3 revision rounds. Post-sign-off: $175/hr.
oneTime.bridge: Includes 30 days of post-launch monitoring and bug fixes. After day 30, Site Growth ($1,600/mo) keeps shipping a new page or section every month.
oneTime.ideal: Growing businesses that publish and sell

oneTime.name: Premium Launch

scope.i: Premium website (15 pages + e-commerce), new build or redesign
scope.l: Fifteen or more fully custom pages built in Next.js with a content management system and an online store. Works for a new site or a redesign. SEO meta data on every page. SSL and hosting setup on Vercel included.
Components, typography and colour defined once and documented, so your team and ours build new pages consistently.
Stripe or Shopify checkout, product pages, cart, order confirmation emails and tax and shipping rules set up for your market.
Login, order history or project files, downloads and account settings, built to what your customers actually need.
Full technical setup plus product and local business schema, Google Business Profile alignment and location pages where relevant.
Core Web Vitals pass on mobile and desktop before launch, including the store and portal pages.
Google Analytics 4 with e-commerce events, Search Console and a monthly view of traffic, orders and top products.
Three structured revision rounds after the first design presentation.
Full professional copywriting for every page is included at this tier.

oneTime.ho: Payment: 50% deposit to start, 25% at midpoint milestone, 25% due upon completion (Net 7). Complete upon sign-off OR 3 rounds. Post-sign-off: $175/hr.
oneTime.bridge: Includes 45 days of post-launch monitoring and bug fixes. After day 45, Site Partnership ($3,800/mo) gives you a dedicated developer and designer.
oneTime.ideal: Established businesses that need e-commerce or a client portal

webSupport.name: Site Care

scope.l: StatusCake or BetterStack watching your site 24/7. Alerts to us immediately. You don’t find out the site is down from a customer.
Full site + database backed up weekly to off-site storage (not just the hosting provider). 30-day retention.
Monthly patching of WordPress core/plugins (if WP) or npm dependencies (if Next.js). Critical security updates applied within 24 hours.
Text updates, image swaps, link fixes, pricing changes, new testimonials. Each edit = under 15 minutes of work.
SSL certificate auto-renewal monitored. Domain expiry warnings 60 days out. DNS health checked quarterly.
1-page monthly report: uptime percentage, average page load times, security events, and any actions taken. Delivered on the 1st.

webSupport.ex: No new pages, no redesigns, no A/B tests, no SEO work. Those live in Site Growth and Site Partnership.
webSupport.ideal: Launched sites that need reliable upkeep and peace of mind

webSupport.name: Site Growth

scope.l: Uptime, backups, security, and minor edits included. Same limits, pulled into this plan.
Each month we ship one new page (up to 1,000 words + standard design) OR a fully redesigned section of an existing page. Your choice.
Hero copy, CTA variants, layout tests, or pricing page experiments. Set up, run, analyze, and recommend winner, all within the month.
Every 3 months: comprehensive audit against Google’s CWV benchmarks. Image compression, code splitting, and critical-path CSS optimized.
Every 3 months: 3-page insights report covering organic traffic, top pages, bounce rates, and search query trends. Recommendations included.
Beyond the Site Care 4-edit baseline: up to 8 total content updates each month. Batched weekly on Mondays.
Slack channel access for quick questions. 24-hour response on all requests. Real-time emergency response is only on the Site Partnership tier.

webSupport.ex: No full redesigns (scoped as a project). No content writing beyond minor edits.
webSupport.ideal: Teams that want the site to keep improving every month

webSupport.name: Site Partnership

scope.l: Monthly new pages, A/B tests, Web Vitals work, quarterly reports, plus expanded limits within this plan.
New features, tests, or optimizations shipped every week. Monday is plan day, Thursday is ship day.
Named developer and designer. Same people every month. They know your stack and your brand. Hours are a budget; anything you don’t use doesn’t roll over.
Comprehensive SEO audit each month: technical (schema, sitemaps, indexing), on-page (keywords, metas, internal linking), and off-page recommendations. Top 3 fixes executed same month.
Up to 10 blog posts or content pages uploaded per month from your copy. Images formatted, meta tags written, internal links suggested. You write, we publish.
Monthly CRO priorities based on analytics + A/B test results. 3 experiments suggested each month; top 2 shipped.
Slack channel with 2-hour response during business hours. Same-day acknowledgment on anything non-urgent.

ov: Additional content page load: $45 each beyond 10
webSupport.ex: No full redesigns (scoped as a project). No mobile app work.
webSupport.ideal: Scaling businesses treating Blok Blok as their web team

careers.meta_description: A five-person studio in Berlin, Richmond, Los Angeles and Multan building websites for clients from Dallas to Manila. How we work and where to send a portfolio.
careers.label: Careers
careers.title: Small team. Real clients. Your name on the work.
careers.intro: Five people across four cities, building for clients from a Dallas plumber to Philippine Airlines. No layers between you and the client, and no templates between you and the work.
careers.how_1_text: Berlin is HQ. The creative director is in Virginia, marketing in Los Angeles, video in Pakistan. Async first, with calls when they earn their place.
careers.how_2_text: One person runs a build end to end and talks to the client directly. The case study carries your work, not a department.
careers.how_3_text: Next.js and React, hand-built. No page builders, no purchased themes. If you like fast sites and clean code, you will like it here.
careers.how_4_text: Every site is judged on what it earns the client: bookings, orders, rankings. We publish the results, so the work has to hold up.
careers.none_text: We hire when a project needs it, usually front-end developers and designers who can also write. Send a portfolio and two lines on what you want to build. We read every one and keep the good ones.

casegrid.luki_proof: Bookings and payments straight through the site. No DMs, no invoices.
casegrid.bronco_proof: $50k+ gross revenue in his first 5 months. 5.0 stars across 52 Google reviews.
casegrid.ripz_proof: $191k in trading card sales, 1,790 orders on the Shopify store we built. The owners have since taken the store down.
